purpose: Research exclusion bound only. It allows an impossible perfect per-file choice among the named already-measured outputs, ignores every time cost, and is not a candidate, score, implementable routing plan, or reward/share forecast. A failing bound excludes only this measured candidate library at the compared x values; it does not rule out new parameter combinations, new token paths, or new algorithms.
selection_definition: For each of the same 28 stage1 file identities, include public361 and the named candidate set, then take minimum output_bytes independently for that file. Record the input file SHA, all tied minimizing candidates and parser SHA, and a deterministic representative source/path.

middle_a_eight_parameter_oracle.metric: unweighted mean of 28 per-file (output_bytes / raw_bytes * 100), matching official mean_file_compression_pct

all_round7_seventeen_candidate_oracle.metric: unweighted mean of 28 per-file (output_bytes / raw_bytes * 100), matching official mean_file_compression_pct

current_frontier_comparison.comparison_scope: Size only: public oracle mean is multiplied by 1.008 and compared with the official frontier y envelope at x=#361 formal time and x=1.02 times that. No time cost of choosing per-file minima is modeled.

interpretation: If public_y*1.008 is at or above the current y threshold, then even the unattainable per-file minimum among these measured candidates cannot enter the published geometric frontier at that fixed x. If it is below, only the size axis has room under this optimistic assumption; timing, admission, stage2, and payout remain unresolved.
